messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: service/redwood-gen streaming p99 latency breached 3s across eu-west-1 and us-west-2. SLOs firing. Auto-fallback not triggered. Paging on-call.

sre-oncall: I'm on it. seeing p95 ~800ms, p99 spiking 3.2-4.5s for streaming responses. concurrent streams increased slightly, but spike looks correlated with yesterday's precision-profile rollout. tagging @ml-infra

ml-infra: thanks. we rolled the int8-profile-2026A to 40% yesterday for gen models at 09:12UTC. calibration job showed minor drift but was within thresholds. pulling logs now.

platform-eng: heap of tail latency from nodes running gpu-pool-6b-int8. KV cache hit-rate ok. the stalls look like long decoding steps — kv-cache stalls + dequant pauses.

support-sre: any customer-facing errors? A couple of 504s for long-poll streaming sessions. CS is seeing increased reconnects for streaming SDKs.

cs-lead: customer-ops reported degraded chat quality and reconnects for two enterprise customers (acme-corp, novahealth). They're asking for mitigation and ETA.

ops-lead: immediate mitigation: route traffic away from int8 pool to high-precision fallback pool (fp16 or int16). @platform-eng can you flip routing policy? We should also enable conservative batching for streaming paths.

platform-eng: starting traffic shift. running rollout command:
```
# route override
POST /admin/routing/override {"svc":"redwood-gen","route":"fp16-fallback","weight":0.6}
```
Applying now. Will monitor.

sre-oncall: applied override. p99 down to ~1.4s in eu-west-1 within 2m. us-west-2 improved to ~1.6s. still some residual tail spikes.

ml-infra: looking at calibration telemetry. int8-profile-2026A shows an uptick in per-layer quant-scale variance at long-context tokens. There's a calibration fallback path that should have triggered but didn't because the drift metric threshold was slightly tuned down during rollout. Filing RDW-4521 to track.

eng-qa: can we force a rollback of the precision profile for affected model groups while we investigate? That should restore previous latency characteristics.

ml-infra: we can, but rollback requires model routing change + warmup. plan: 1) pause further int8 rollouts; 2) rollback profile for gen-6b to int8-profile-2025Z; 3) keep fp16 fallback in place for 60m. I'll execute step 2 now.

ml-infra: rollback initiated. command used:
```
rbac apply-profile --model gen-6b --profile int8-profile-2025Z --force
```

incident-bot: Deploy/rollback job queued: job/rollback-gen-6b-3177777777-1. Notifying on-call.

sre-oncall: after rollback p99 back to ~700-900ms across regions. streaming reconnects dropping. marking as mitigated for customer impact. still leave override for 30m then remove if stable.

cs-lead: telling customers: "we detected performance degradation affecting streaming; routed traffic to a higher-precision fallback and rolled back the recent precision profile while we investigate. No data loss. We're monitoring and will follow up with a postmortem." :white_check_mark:

ops-lead: action items —
• ml-infra: root cause analysis on why calibration fallback threshold didn't fire (RDW-4521)
• platform-eng: audit routing boolean that blocks auto-fallback when override present
• sre-oncall: keep monitoring and collect traces for affected sessions
• eng-qa: add synthetic long-context streaming test to catch this class of drift

eng-qa: added test case in CI: `streaming-long-context-latency.yml` to run during canaries.

ml-infra: preliminary cause: calibration telemetry smoothing masked a short-lived variance spike; our gating rule missed the window. Also profiling shows a dequantization lock for a specific attention kernel under certain sequence lengths.

platform-eng: temp mitigation note: keep fp16-fallback route with low weight (0.3) until we confirm new calibration thresholds safe. manual auto-fallback re-enable blocked until postmortem.

sre-oncall: updating incident channel and handoff. current status: mitigated (routing rollback done), severity reduced. preserving traces & graphs in /incidents/3177777777/artifacts.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity -> reduced. Pages cleared for on-call.

sre-oncall: handing off to night shift at 02:00UTC. next oncall: "sre-oncall-night". leave all tickets open. tagging assignees.

cs-lead: opened customer incident notes and will follow up with detailed timeline after postmortem.

ml-infra: ETA for full RCA + remediation plan ~48h. will propose tighter fallback gating and a preflight check for quant profile rollouts.

ops-lead: good work. please ensure RDW-4521 has replicas of logs and the exact calibration metrics used. we'll schedule a hotfix for the gating logic if needed.

sre-oncall: copying summary into #postmortems and creating a short runbook entry for 'precision-profile tail latency' for future pages.

customer-ops: thanks for the quick mitigation. please add us to the followup timeline.

incident-bot: Incident thread closed for active paging. Thread will remain for follow-up and postmortem."
